title: Canada Disability Benefit Act
verified_how: Located as C-3.45 on the A-Z list at /eng/acts/C.html, then fetched the index page: title 'Canada Disability Benefit Act', citation (S.C. 2023, c. 17), current to 2026-07-21, last amended 2024-06-22.
notes: A framework Act; amounts and eligibility are set in the Canada Disability Benefit Regulations. The page carries the site's generic 'not in force' notice text; I did not individually check whether every provision is in force. The Canada child benefit sits in the Income Tax Act (s. 122.6 onward).
